stepHint.salon: The key things are the name, specialty and owner phone — the owner signs in with it.
stepHint.place: Tap the button when you are at the entrance — the spot is saved.
stepHint.photos: Take photos of the salon and its work — clients see them right away, no review needed. Without photos the salon is not listed.
stepHint.masters: Name and phone — the specialist gets an invitation. Skip it if the owner works alone.
stepHint.services: Typical services are already ticked — untick what they do not offer. Prices can be edited later.
stepHint.hours: Switch on working days and set the time. Days off stay off.
stepHint.summary: Check what will be created and tap “Connect salon”.
